resources.string: Put some time to your calendar to take a walk outside or meet new people
Listen to audiobook or podcast to explore or discover new stuff regarding my careers and making new friend at work and outside work
Spend at least 30 minutes learning a new Android or Kotlin concept every day
Drink enough water throughout the day and avoid skipping meals while working
Take a short break from screens and stretch your body after long coding sessions
Read a book or article that improves your mindset, productivity, or communication skills
Practice gratitude by writing down three good things that happened during the day
Spend quality time with family and friends without distractions from phone or work
Work on a personal project or contribute to open source to sharpen development skills
Sleep early and give your body enough rest to stay productive and mentally fresh
